checkpoint_metadata.scope: Unmodified deterministic actor mean; no exploration noise, no fine tuning.

criteria.fall: any height <.20 m or tilt >60 deg over entire rollout
criteria.velocity: per-axis MAE <=max(.03 m/s,20% command) for commanded translation; <=.05 m/s on zero translation axes; yaw <=max(.05 rad/s,20% command), zero-yaw <=.10 rad/s; no fall
criteria.stop: last-second mean horizontal speed <=.1 m/s and mean absolute yaw rate <=.15 rad/s; no fall
criteria.posture: moving steady-window height >=.28 m and tilt <=25 deg
criteria.contact: all-rollout peak nonwheel net contact force <50 N, using a full four-physics-step sensor history

scope: Native PhysX frozen deterministic Actor only. Flat nominal AS2W mass/PD; no dynamics randomization, observation noise, pushes, prior, teacher, hand-coded motion takeover, or auto-reset. Repeat0 nominal, remaining fixed small-pose perturbations and random headings; not a broad robustness study.
